relationships.subject: NLRP3
relationships.evidence_quote: suppressing neuroinflammation through NOD-like receptor protein 3 (NLRP3) inflammasome inhibition and promotion of anti-inflammatory glial polarization

key_findings: Review of fibromyalgia pathophysiology and repurposed drugs (NMDA antagonists, NK1 antagonists, GABAergic, cannabinoids, antidiabetics).
Proposes NLRP3 inhibition, glial polarization and descending inhibition as future frontiers.
